coins.name: The Toad Pepe
coins.description:
I will not run this coin. You are more than welcome to CTO it.

The real first Pepe appeared in 1988 on Argentine TV in the children’s show of Carlitos Balá, as El Sapo Pepe.

Decades later, Matt Furie would present his own frog, sharing the same name

PEPE was born

coins.name: Doom
coins.description:
Doom is a legendary first-person shooter game, considered one of the first pioneering first-person shooter games. The game that invented a genre and became a cultural icon for over 30 years.

One of gaming's founding fathers. Decades of cult status.
